basis.governing_question: How can Grupo Vale integrate the sales, purchasing and finance of the three regional food distributors it has bought into its own?

sub_questions.question: Where do each acquired company's sales, purchasing and finance differ from Grupo Vale's processes and systems?
How should each company's sales, purchasing and finance run on Grupo Vale's processes and systems?
In what sequence, with what steps and owners, are the three companies integrated?
What does it take to run the first company's sales, purchasing and finance on Grupo Vale's processes and systems?
What does the first company's move change in the three-company plan before it goes to the board?

drivers.evidence: Grupo Vale has bought three regional food distributors

work.unit: Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phase_work.why: Three companies diagnosed two at a time, so two rounds; within the archetype's typical 4-8 weeks.

work.unit: Target model for sales, purchasing and finance on Grupo Vale's processes
Unit-level design detailed with the unit's leaders

phase_work.why: Target model first, then the three company designs two at a time, then the transition plan; within the archetype's 6-10 weeks.

work.unit: First company's process area set up on Grupo Vale's systems and tested
Data migration rehearsal and cutover for the first company
First company live and stable on Grupo Vale's processes

phase_work.why: Two process areas set up at a time, then migration rehearsal, cutover and a stable run, one after another; phase not in the archetype.

sizing.levers: Diagnosing one company in full and the other two from data, and running all three process areas at once, would shorten most.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish how sales, purchasing and finance work in each acquired company and where they differ from Grupo Vale's.

gate.label: Go/no-go on design
gate.decision: Go or no-go on design, scoped to the sales, purchasing and finance gaps found?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define how each company's sales, purchasing and finance move onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems, and the integration sequence.

gate.label: Design sign-off
gate.decision: Approve the integration design and go ahead with moving the first company?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Move the first company's sales, purchasing and finance onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems and finalize the three-company plan.

gate.label: Board pack sign-off
gate.decision: Approve the integration plan and the first company's results to take to the board?

architect_notes: Length is not stated: phases are cut to the 12 weeks available, but the work adds up to 20-30 weeks.
Implementation covers only the first company, which the brief does not name; moving the other two companies is not in these phases.
Operating model redesign has no Implementation phase; one is added after Design, and Design is sized to three functions, not a whole-organization target model.
Implementation weeks are an estimate outside the library and assume Grupo Vale's existing systems take the first company, with no system selection.
